message.reasoning:
The user wants to play Monopoly.

I'm p2 with $529 and four properties. I just bought North Carolina Avenue from p4 and now need Pennsylvania Avenue to complete the green monopoly. p1 has $606 and owns several properties including Vermont, Electric Company, and St. James. He also needs New York Avenue to complete his orange monopoly.

p3 has $1435 and scattered properties. p4 now has $1750 and no properties after selling North Carolina to me. I need to land on Pennsylvania Avenue, which costs $320.

I'll keep cash to buy Pennsylvania Avenue when I land there. I won't mortgage anything yet. Trading with p1 for light purple properties isn't worth the cash. p3's Penn RR would only bring in $50 in rent, so that trade is also unappealing.

St. Charles Place doesn't complete a monopoly for me. p1's Short Line is another unhelpful rail option. I won't trade away my green properties or spend cash on them. Mediterranean Avenue is nearly worthless, and Baltic is unowned so it can't be traded for either.

I'll end the turn. No trade is worth spending cash on, and p3 would never accept a swap of Mediterranean Avenue for Pennsylvania Railroad.
